* Create and enforce structured input/output contracts (JSON schemas) and API interfaces between the application layer and downstream agents/services.
* Combine user intent, conversation history, screen and workflow context, and filters to produce robust downstream agent requests.
* Implement capability discovery, reusable skill creation, and registries or catalogs for agents and tools.
* Transform agent responses into grounded, user\-facing outputs: narratives, tables, charts, citations, and consistent response payloads.
* Build, test, and deploy GenAI services on AWS (including Amazon Bedrock) and AgentCore or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Deliver production\-ready code with automated tests, monitoring, and clear documentation.
* Collaborate with product, data, and platform teams to evolve APIs, contracts, and observability for GenAI applications.

* Strong backend engineering experience in Python or TypeScript, with production\-grade code and testing practices.
* Direct production experience with agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow routing, and multi\-agent chaining.
* Proven API and schema design skills; experience defining structured JSON input/output contracts.
* Experience combining user intent, conversation context, screen/workflow metadata, and filters into downstream agent requests.
* Demonstrated ability to transform agent results into narratives, tables, charts, citations and consistent application responses.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying GenAI services with AWS and Amazon Bedrock, and familiarity with AgentCore (or similar orchestrators).
* Ability to work independently and deliver tested, production\-ready features with minimal guidance.



 Preferred qualifications
 


* Experience building capability registries, agent and tool catalogs, workflow skills, or discovery services.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model\-Centric Platform) and API\-first GenAI application patterns.
* Experience building analytics or visualization layers on top of semantic\-layer or data\-query agents.
* Knowledge of observability for multi\-agent systems: tracing, schema validation, SLA metrics, and auditability.
* Background in security, data governance, and handling of citations/attributions in generative outputs.



 What we offer
 


* Competitive salary and equity.
* Health benefits, paid time off, and professional development stipend.
* Opportunity to shape a foundational GenAI application layer used across the enterprise.
* Collaborative team with product, data, and platform partners.



 Interview process (high\-level)
 


* Recruiter screen

* Deep technical interview: agent orchestration and API/schema design, sample design challenge
